title: Fix blacklist predicate = 0 in admin and CLI
description: admin.rs:419,458 and cli/ops.rs:24 use blacklisted_until IS NULL OR blacklisted_until = 0 to find non-blacklisted peers. The correct check (used in peer_registry.rs and blacklist.rs) is blacklisted_until IS NULL OR blacklisted_until <= now_ms. The = 0 variant incorrectly includes peers with active future blacklist timestamps in active-peer lists.
